lines: Today's Word (.docx) and OpenDocument (.odt) files, opened on a 1992 PowerBook Duo 230: 68030, 33 MHz, 8 MB, System 7.
Unzipped, parsed and drawn on the Mac itself, pictures included.

caption: A 2026 .docx: headings, lists, a table, umlauts, «», π Ω, recomposed accents, and stand-ins where Mac OS Roman has no letter.
System 7 has no € in Mac OS Roman or any bitmap font, so WordReader draws it with QuickDraw.
An .odt from LibreOffice: centred and right-aligned text, bold, italic, underline, sizes, hanging indents, nested lists, a table.
New in 1.2: PNG and JPEG decoded on the Mac, shrunk while decoding and dithered to 16 greys. The photo is 1600 × 1000 pixels.
Document Info: the text in 1.5 s, four pictures in 29.5 s, the photo in 15.7 s, all on a 33 MHz 68030 with no FPU.
Select and copy: Command-C puts plain Mac OS Roman text on the clipboard, ready for TeachText. Save as Text works too.
